description:
Title : Abinitio Developer
 Location : Hartford, CT.
 Duration : Full Time (Permanent)
 Required: 
 Must have 6+ years total experience with at least 4+ years experience on AbInitio
 Strong knowledge of data warehouse concepts
 Very strong knowledge of Ab Initio (basic & advanced)
 Exposure to Ab Initio TDM would be an added advantage
 Excellent communication skills and comfortable working in a client facing role
 Expected to work in technical design, development and testing of the changes
 Maintain existing Ab Initio graphs by adjusting the graphs and/or writing Shell Scripts as needed and subset, extract and load data using them based on the requirements
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
